answer: We formulate a Sybil-resistant mechanism deploying dynamic opportunity-cost bonds backed by staking collateral and subgame-perfect slashing penalties via zero-knowledge verifiable delay. This capital barrier analysis proves the expected payoff of identity multiplication is strictly negative, as any falcon simulating parallel identities at the protocol wharf must lock vast liquid capital. Consequently, the adversarial environment converges to a robust Nash equilibrium, ensuring the decentralized system remains fortified like an ivory vault against attacks.
